repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly re-executes the pre-cycle actions (closing the valve and sending mail) in the `else` branch of the periodic loop. The IR specifies that the cycle body (sending mail) repeats every 1 minute, but the valve should only be closed once during the initial wait-and-call sequence before the cycle begins.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the duplicate `valve_close()` and `emailProvider_sendMail()` calls from the `else` block. The revised script now executes the initial wait and single valve close, followed by a periodic loop that only performs the email sending action as specified by the IR.
